description: This file is a C++ source code implementing a web client test application. It defines a WebClient class that manages HTTP requests over a secure websocket connection, including request submission, authentication, and connection management. The main function provides an interactive console to control the web client operations.

classes.name: WebClient
classes.description: A class that manages a secure websocket-based HTTP client, capable of sending requests, handling responses, and managing connection states.

methods.name: LinkBody
methods.description: Attaches a text body to the response when a partial request is received.

methods.name: Received
methods.description: Handles the reception of a response, printing its contents.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends a request, printing its contents.

methods.name: StateChange
methods.description: Handles changes in connection state, printing status messages.

methods.name: Submit
methods.description: Submits an HTTP GET request to a predefined host and path.

methods.name: SubmitAuthRequest
methods.description: Creates and submits an authenticated HTTP GET request with a Basic Authorization header.
